abs_anti_lock_braking_system.definition: The ABS has a fault. Normal braking still works, but the wheels can lock under heavy braking. Severity level 3 — Warning. Action: Have the ABS checked. Until then, brake earlier and more gently..

mother.definition: The woman who looks after you and lives with you.
mother.example: My mother works at a shop in the market.

prompt.definition: The instruction and the context you give a model. Writing a good one is a real skill, not a magic formula.
prompt.example: A one-line prompt gave me a generic answer; a prompt with the audience and the length gave me a usable one.
